title: "AI Agent"
description: "Shell wrappers that pipe terminal input to Claude and Codex CLIs"

---

Scripts in this category let you drive AI agents directly from the command line.
They are designed to be **composable** — pipe any command output into them as context.

| Script | Backend | Summary |
|--------|---------|---------|
| [claude-stdin-prompt](claude-stdin-prompt.qmd) | Claude CLI | Pipe stdin + a prompt to Claude; returns the response to stdout |
| [codex-stdin-prompt](codex-stdin-prompt.qmd) | OpenAI Codex CLI | Same pattern for the OpenAI Codex agent |
| [generate-headline](generate-headline.qmd) | Claude or Codex | Re-phrase text into three headline styles (shortened / noun-ending / slide-title) |

## Typical pattern

```bash
# Any command whose output you want analyzed
<command> | <agent-script> -p "your instruction"
```

Examples:

```bash
git diff --cached | claude-stdin-prompt -p "Write a commit message"
cat meeting-notes.md | generate-headline
curl -s api/data.json | codex-stdin-prompt --model o4-mini -p "Summarize this JSON"
```
